purpose: A textual lifecycle status for new, in-review, in-progress, completed, or cancelled records.
behaviorProvider: Static record workflow label and StatusDot.

component: StatusBadge always combines a decorative StatusDot with the corresponding visible workflow label.
Standalone StatusDot defaults to a named image role; label=false deliberately hides it from assistive technology. Map workflow states to shared semantic status roles.
host: Supply the record workflow state and own state transitions, authorization and persistence.
Use PresenceIndicator for availability; these record states do not represent online/offline status.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: No state machine, transition guard or live announcement is supplied.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
